configuration.grapheme_clustering: Enabled for AkiTTY and libghostty-vt, native behavior for Alacritty and Kitty
configuration.fixture: Maximum whole UTF-8 pattern repeats in one feed of at most 8192 bytes
configuration.reported_rate: Median of per-pass rates, computed from the median elapsed time and 1 MiB = 1048576 bytes
configuration.timed_scope: Direct headless feed, excluding grid setup, destruction and state extraction. Kitty includes its Python test API calls and an input copy.
configuration.validation: Last grid of every sample: normalized visible rows (trailing spaces and wide-cell placeholders omitted), cursor position, active screen, retained history count and first-column foregrounds. Additional probes check in-flight alternate screen state, truecolor and Unicode cursor advances.
